<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { DnDProvider } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import { describe, type LoggedEvent } from './describe';
import TaskColumn from './TaskColumn.vue';
import EventInspector from './EventInspector.vue';

const todo = ref([
  { id: 'docs', title: 'Write docs' },
  { id: 'bug', title: 'Fix #42' },
]);
const done = ref([{ id: 'ship', title: 'Ship v3' }]);

// Every event of the drag, described when it fires. A new drag starts a new log;
// moves fire every frame, so they share one entry, which keeps the latest.
const events = ref<LoggedEvent[]>([]);
let count = 0;
const record = (name: string, type: string, payload: unknown) => {
  if (name === 'onDragStart') events.value = [];
  const lines = describe(type, payload);
  const move = name === 'onDragMove' && events.value.find((event) => event.name === name);
  if (move) Object.assign(move, { lines, count: move.count + 1 });
  else events.value.push({ id: ++count, name, type, lines, count: 1 });
};
</script>

<template>

    <div class="demo">
      <div class="columns">
        <TaskColumn id="todo" v-model="todo" :record="record" />
        <TaskColumn id="done" v-model="done" :record="record" />
      </div>
      <EventInspector :events="events" :record="record" />
    </div>
  </DnDProvider>
</template>

/**
 * An event payload as console-like lines, taken when the event fires (the drag state
 * moves on right after). Elements print as `<li.task>`, functions as `ƒ name()`; a value
 * that fits on one line stays on one line.
 */
export interface Token {
  text: string;
  kind?: 'key' | 'string' | 'number' | 'literal' | 'type';
}
export interface Line {
  depth: number;
  tokens: Token[];
}
/** An event of the log, as it was when it fired. Moves share one entry: `count`. */
export interface LoggedEvent {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  lines: Line[];
  count: number;
}

const MAX_INLINE = 54;
const MAX_DEPTH = 4;

const leaf = (value: unknown): Token | null => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || typeof value === 'boolean') return { text: String(value), kind: 'literal' };
  if (typeof value === 'number') return { text: String(Math.round(value)), kind: 'number' };
  if (typeof value === 'string') return { text: `'${value}'`, kind: 'string' };
  if (typeof value === 'function') return { text: `ƒ ${value.name}()`, kind: 'literal' };
  if (value instanceof Element) {
    const name = value.classList[0];
    return { text: `<${value.tagName.toLowerCase()}${name ? `.${name}` : ''}>`, kind: 'literal' };
  }
  return null;
};

type Entry = [label: Token[], value: unknown];

const open = (value: object): { start: string; end: string; entries: Entry[] } => {
  if (value instanceof Map) {
    return { start: `Map(${value.size}) {`, end: '}', entries: [...value].map(([key, item]) => [[leaf(key)!, { text: ' => ' }], item]) };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return { start: '[', end: ']', entries: value.map((item) => [[], item]) };
  return { start: '{', end: '}', entries: Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [[{ text: key, kind: 'key' }, { text: ': ' }], item]) };
};

const inline = (value: unknown, depth: number): Token[] => {
  const single = leaf(value);
  if (single) return [single];
  const { start, end, entries } = open(value as object);
  if (!entries.length) return [{ text: start === '[' ? '[]' : `${start}}` }];
  if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) return [{ text: start === '[' ? '[…]' : '{…}' }];
  const pad = start === '[' ? '' : ' ';
  const tokens: Token[] = [{ text: start + pad }];
  entries.forEach(([label, item], index) => {
    if (index) tokens.push({ text: ', ' });
    tokens.push(...label, ...inline(item, depth + 1));
  });
  tokens.push({ text: pad + end });
  return tokens;
};

const width = (tokens: Token[]) => tokens.reduce((sum, token) => sum + token.text.length, 0);

export function describe(type: string, value: unknown): Line[] {
  const lines: Line[] = [];
  const walk = (label: Token[], item: unknown, depth: number, last: boolean) => {
    const comma = last ? [] : [{ text: ',' }];
    const tokens = inline(item, depth);
    if (leaf(item) || width(label) + width(tokens) + depth * 2 <= MAX_INLINE) {
      lines.push({ depth, tokens: [...label, ...tokens, ...comma] });
      return;
    }
    const { start, end, entries } = open(item as object);
    lines.push({ depth, tokens: [...label, { text: start }] });
    entries.forEach(([childLabel, child], index) => walk(childLabel, child, depth + 1, index === entries.length - 1));
    lines.push({ depth, tokens: [{ text: end }, ...comma] });
  };
  walk([{ text: `${type} `, kind: 'type' }], value, 0, true);
  return lines;
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { useDnDMonitor } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import type { LoggedEvent } from './describe';

const props = defineProps<{ events: LoggedEvent[]; record: (name: string, type: string, payload: unknown) => void }>();

// `null`: follow the newest event.
const chosen = ref<number | null>(null);
const shown = computed(() => props.events.find((event) => event.id === chosen.value) ?? props.events.at(-1));

// The newest events stay in view.
const timeline = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('timeline');
watch(
  () => props.events.length,
  () => timeline.value?.scrollTo({ top: timeline.value.scrollHeight }),
  { flush: 'post' },
);

// Every drag under the provider, wherever it starts. Monitors hear `onBeforeDrop` first.
useDnDMonitor({
  onDragStart: (event) => {
    chosen.value = null;
    props.record('onDragStart', 'DnDEvent', event);
  },
  onDragMove: (event) => props.record('onDragMove', 'DnDEvent', event),
  onDragOver: (event) => props.record('onDragOver', 'DnDEvent', event),
  onBeforeDrop: (event) => props.record('onBeforeDrop', 'DnDEvent', event),
  onDragEnd: (event) => {
    props.record('onDragEnd', 'DnDEndEvent', event);
    // Open the list's drop event: it carries `result`, the lists as the drop leaves them.
    chosen.value = props.events.find((entry) => entry.name.endsWith('.onDrop'))?.id ?? null;
  },
  onDragCancel: (event) => props.record('onDragCancel', 'DnDEvent', event),
});
</script>

<template>
  <section class="inspector" aria-label="Events">
    <div ref="timeline" class="timeline">
      <button
        v-for="event in events"
        :key="event.id"
        type="button"
        :aria-pressed="event === shown"
        @click="chosen = event.id"
      >
        {{ event.name }}<span v-if="event.count > 1" class="times"> ×{{ event.count }}</span>
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="payload">
      <template v-if="shown">
        <div v-for="(line, index) in shown.lines" :key="index" class="code-line" :style="{ '--depth': line.depth }">
          <span v-for="(token, at) in line.tokens" :key="at" :class="token.kind">{{ token.text }}</span>
        </div>
      </template>
      <p v-else class="empty">Drag a task: its events land here, payloads in full.</p>
    </div>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

const { items, isOver } = makeSortableList(list, {
  id: props.id,
  items: tasks,
  group: 'events',
  onBeforeDrop: (event) => props.record(`${props.id}.onBeforeDrop`, 'SortableDropEvent', event),
  onDrop: (event) => props.record(`${props.id}.onDrop`, 'SortableDropEvent', event),
});
</script>
